scenarios.request: cover this conversation between Mara and Joon
scenarios.why: A two-person talk is covered over the shoulders, both cameras on one side.

scenarios.request: give me master and coverage for the dinner scene
scenarios.why: The safety net: a wide master, then mediums and close-ups.
A reverse on him starts the exchange from his side.

scenarios.request: walk and talk down the corridor
scenarios.why: The talk moves, so the coverage travels with it.

scenarios.request: clean singles for the argument, no shoulders
scenarios.why: Clean singles keep each speaker alone in the frame: colder, more divided.
A fight is action coverage: establish, track, punch in, react; "fight" is not a slip for "tight".

scenarios.request: start on the city and funnel in to Mara
scenarios.why: From the place to the person, one step closer each shot.

scenarios.request: a branching argument: give me full coverage so the editor can pick
scenarios.why: A scene that may be cut many ways needs edit-safe full coverage.

scenarios.request: chase coverage for the alley run
scenarios.why: A chase is covered like action: space first, then pace, then the beat.
Three people arguing is a triangle: a master, then each speaking pair over the shoulder and in singles.

scenarios.request: give me triangle coverage of Mara, Joon and Sela
scenarios.why: Naming all three puts each of them in the triangle, in the order said.

scenarios.request: cover the group around the table
scenarios.why: A table of people is a wide and a single of each, taken from inside the circle.
Each branch of an interactive talk is cut from the same setups, laid once.

scenarios.request: a dialogue tree with two branches for Mara and Joon
scenarios.why: A dialogue tree is branching coverage; the count names how many branches.

scenarios.request: is my coverage enough to edit?
scenarios.why: Over-the-shoulders alone leave no master and one size each: not enough to edit.

scenarios.request: what is missing from the coverage of Mara and Joon?
scenarios.why: Master and coverage gives a master and three sizes each, so nothing is missing.
